Alif, Lam, Meem. These are letters. Only Allah knows what they mean.
The Book is sent down from the Lord of all. There is no doubt in it.
But they say: He made it up. No, it is the truth from your Lord, to warn people who had no warner before you, so they may find the right way.
Allah is the One who made the skies and the earth and all between them in six days. Then He rose over the Throne. You have no helper or protector except Him. Will you not think?
He plans everything from the sky to the earth. Then it goes up to Him in a day that is a thousand years by your count.
That is the One who knows what is hidden and what is seen. He is the Strong, the Kind.
He made everything He created perfect. He began the making of man from clay.
Then He made his children from a tiny drop of weak fluid.
Then He shaped him and breathed His spirit into him. And He gave you ears, eyes and hearts. But you hardly say thank you.
They say: When we are lost in the earth, will we be made new again? No, they do not believe they will meet their Lord.
Say: The angel of death, who is in charge of you, will take you. Then you will be sent back to your Lord.
If only you could see the bad people with their heads low before their Lord: Our Lord, we saw and we heard. Send us back and we will do good. Now we are sure!
If We wanted, We could have given every person his guidance. But My word is true: I will fill Hell with jinn and people, all together.
So taste it! You forgot that you would meet this Day, so We forgot you. Taste the punishment that never ends for what you used to do.
Only those who believe in Our verses are those who, when they are reminded of them, fall down to bow and praise their Lord, and are not proud.
They get up from their beds to pray to their Lord with fear and hope. And they give from what We gave them.
No one knows what joy for the eyes is hidden for them. It is a reward for what they used to do.
Is a believer like a sinner? They are not the same.
As for those who believe and do good, they get the Gardens of the Home, as a welcome for what they used to do.
But as for those who did wrong, their home is the Fire. Each time they try to get out, they are put back in. They are told: Taste the punishment of the Fire that you said was a lie.
We will let them taste a smaller punishment before the bigger punishment, so that they may come back.
Who does more wrong than the one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord and turns away from them? We will punish the bad people.
We gave Musa the Book. So do not doubt that you will meet Him. We made it a guide for the Children of Israel.
And We made leaders from among them who guided by Our order, as long as they were patient and sure of Our verses.
Your Lord will decide between them on the Day of Judgment about what they argued about.
Is it not a lesson for them how many people before them We destroyed, whose homes they walk through now? There are signs in that. Do they not listen?
Do they not see how We bring water to dry land and grow plants with it, which their animals and they themselves eat? Do they not see?
They say: When will this win come, if you are telling the truth?
Say: On the day of the win, believing will not help the people who said no, and they will not be given time.
So turn away from them and wait. They are waiting too.
